question: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Operating expenses (GAAP))

calls.reasoning: Q1 FY27 GAAP opex 7.62, Q2 8.41, Q3 guide 9.2. Sequential guide-to-guide steps have been +0.7-0.9B (Q3->Q4 FY26 5.9->6.7; Q2->Q3 FY27 8.5->9.2). On the Q2 call management said full-year FY27 opex is expected to grow in the low 50s%; on FY26 GAAP base 23.08B, 50-54% growth less Q1-Q3 (25.23) implies Q4 of ~9.4-10.3B, and a recast non-GAAP base gives ~10.1. Center ~10.0. Risks: a Q3 actual above or below the guide, a revision to the full-year growth figure, imprecision in 'low 50s'. Market check: no Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold market on opex guidance found (only earnings beat, gross margin and mention markets).
calls.dossier:
- Q1 FY27 actual (NVIDIA PR, May 2026): GAAP opex $7.621B, non-GAAP $7.449B. Q2 guide given then: GAAP ~$8.5B, non-GAAP ~$8.3B.
- Q2 FY27 actual (NVIDIA PR, Aug 26 2026): GAAP opex $8.408B, non-GAAP $8.232B; GAAP up 10% q/q, non-GAAP up 11% q/q (compute infrastructure, compensation).
- Q3 FY27 guide (Aug 26 2026): GAAP ~$9.2B, non-GAAP ~$9.0B.
- Q2 FY27 call (Kress, Aug 2026): 'For full year, we now expect OpEx to grow in the low 50s' (percent), driven by a broader product portfolio and more use of AI tools. The word 'now' implies a revision from an earlier figure.
- FY26 (NVIDIA PR, Feb 2026): full-year GAAP opex $23.076B; non-GAAP (excluding SBC) $16.694B; total SBC $6.386B. Q4 FY26 GAAP opex $6.794B (guide was ~$6.7B); Q3 FY26 guide ~$5.9B, actual $5.84B.
- Starting Q1 FY27, non-GAAP measures no longer exclude stock-based compensation, so the GAAP vs non-GAAP gap is now about $0.2B.
- Arithmetic: FY26 GAAP x1.50/1.52/1.54 = 34.6/35.1/35.5; minus Q1+Q2+Q3guide (25.23) leaves Q4 of 9.4/9.9/10.3.
- Guide-to-guide steps: Q3->Q4 FY26 +0.8B; Q2->Q3 FY27 +0.7B; Q1 actual -> Q2 guide +0.9B.
- Q3 FY27 report date: Nov 17 2026 after close. Analysts expect revenue above the guide midpoint (~$111B consensus).
- News Nov 2026: reports about the CEO's personal conduct (Polymarket contracts on his tenure); no stated link to opex.
- Resolves off the midpoint of the GAAP opex guide in the Q3 FY27 release 'Outlook' section (usually a single 'approximately' figure), rounded to $0.1B, not the non-GAAP figure.
- Event window: release on Nov 17 2026; as of Nov 10 2026 it has not happened yet.
